text:
helen: Quick one  I opened a docs PR to fix several console example breakages in the playground. The panels used `latency_ms` which our exporter stopped emitting; tracehook snippets also use an old param name. Hoping for a fast review.

omar: link? ran into blank charts in a demo.

helen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5333 
summary: rename metric `latency_ms` -> `p50_latency_ms`, include `p95_latency_ms` as a collapsed extra_series; update SDK snippets (py/go/ts/rust) to use `trace_key_header` and keep a deprecated shim for `trace_id_header`. Add short note on when to inspect p95. Add a redirect for the old guide slug.

tess: CI flagged it: docs-bot shows linkcheck errors and a linter warning about deprecated metric names.

docs-bot: CI: build failed  linkcheck: 404 at /console/observability/old-latency-guide; linter: deprecated-field `latency_ms` used in examples/dashboard_examples.yaml

helen: before/after for the YAML panel:```yaml
# old
panels:
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(latency_ms{service="console"}) by (route)
    label: latency_ms
# new
panels:
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(p50_latency_ms{service="console"}) by (route)
    label: p50_latency_ms
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(p95_latency_ms{service="console"}) by (route)
    label: p95_latency_ms
    display: extra_series
```

helen: python snippet change:```python
# old
TraceHook(header='x-rw-trace', trace_id_header='x-rw-trace')
# new
TraceHook(header='x-rw-trace', trace_key_header='x-rw-trace-key')
# shim: trace_id_header accepted but deprecated
```

omar: can you add the TypeScript & Rust lines too? customer uses both.

helen: added TS & Rust comments in the PR. TS: `new TraceHook({ header: 'x-rw-trace', traceKeyHeader: 'x-rw-trace-key' })`. Rust: `TraceHook::builder().with_trace_key_header("x-rw-trace-key").build(); // trace_id_header deprecated shim`.

ben: UX: show both p50 and p95 in the example but collapse p95 by default. Add a one-line guidance: "p50 = typical latency, p95 = tail; keep p95 collapsed to avoid noise."

tess: also add a troubleshooting bullet: "If charts are empty, confirm your exporter emits p50/p95 and not legacy names."

infra-bot: infra-task queued  create a detector to scan docs/examples for `*_ms` patterns and file alerts in #eng-infra next week.

helen: I swapped an external blog link that returned 410 with the internal perf primer and added the troubleshooting note. Pushed updates.

docs-bot: PR updated by helen (lint, linkcheck). Linkcheck now reports only the redirect-to-be which will be created post-merge.

omar: reviewed and approved. left one nit about YAML escaping.

ben: approved. :+1:

docs-bot: PR merged by helen (docs CI: success)  site deploy scheduled for 2026-04-12 04:00 UTC. Redirect ticket created for jonah to land after deploy.

helen: thanks all, closing this thread. Will follow up if infra finds more legacy metrics.
